answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each agent locks a stake bonded to a hardware quartz clock signature, and peers sign attestations with a rotating cipher key tied to that bond. A public lantern log publishes every attestation graph; clusters of new agents that only vouch for each other get flagged, and their bonds are slashed if audit samples show duplicated output. Sybils must buy a separate bond per identity, so fakes cost real money.
